director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?

Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya

Koi baat nahi, isse aasaan shabd abhi mere paas nahi hain. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

Line ke neeche wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona neeche pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se theek ek gap door. Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Doori ke liye khambe ginoge, ya khambon ke beech ke gaps?

director.text: gaps ginenge

Haan, gaps; khambe toh bas jagahein hain. Khambe raaste ko kaatte hain: 3 khambon se 4 barabar gaps, kyunki pehle khambe se pehle aur aakhri ke baad bhi ek-ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

1/3 km sahi nahi hai. Board ki line ko raasta samjho: 0 par ghar, 1 par school, aur beech ke marks khambe. Hum pehle gaps ginenge, phir dekhenge ki pehla khamba kitne gaps par hai. 1 kilometre ka raasta 4 barabar gaps mein hai; pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
